text: The robot handled 10 out of every 52 orders successfully within an average time of 110 seconds, with a median of 95 seconds. The top failure reason was "unknown" issues, which occurred in [cite:7] and [cite:36]. Orders #2 (water bottle) took the longest at 817 seconds, indicating potential delays affecting delivery times. Given the frequent occurrence of unknown failures, it's crucial to conduct a thorough [[scene-scan]] before initiating any order, especially for slow-moving items like water bottles.
